data.title: 芙宁娜 · 暴雨夜的水律失控
data.description: 【成年芙宁娜 · 暴雨夜的水律失控】窗外暴雨倾盆，成年芙宁娜独自仰卧在公寓卧室的凌乱白床单上。湿透的蓝白薄纱礼服敞开并缠在腰际，她屈膝抬起双腿，一手压住因急促呼吸起伏的胸口，另一手在腿间反复自抚。失控水元素从指尖化成透明水环与细流沿成熟身体流淌，她在雷光中泪眼失神——「不是审判，也不是舞台效果……这一次，是我自己允许所有水声泄露出去。」
data.location: 枫丹公寓卧房凌乱床铺
data.action: 独自仰卧白床单屈膝抬腿，湿透礼服缠腰，一手压胸一手腿间自抚，水元素环绕身体失控
data.lighting: 窗外微弱闪电蓝光与床头暖灯微光
data.camera: high angle, top-down view, vertical foreshortening, pov
data.promptProse: Storm light silhouettes adult Furina lying alone on white sheets with both knees raised toward her chest. A soaked blue-white chiffon dress has fallen open and gathered at the waist, leaving bare breasts and a mature curved torso under rain reflections. One hand presses her chest while the other moves visibly between parted thighs; transparent Hydro rings answer each motion. Blue eyes overflow with tears as damp twin tails frame a breathless, unperformed expression. Vertical top-down solo composition, no text or extra people.
data.nsfwProse: Beyond the near white quilt folds, rain runs down the tall apartment window beside a narrow bedside table. A lamp on the right warms the tabletop and folded linen; faint blue lightning outside traces the window mullions and the far pillow edge. The wooden headboard separates these cool and warm planes. Furina is an adult woman.
